pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal reddish-brown patches with relatively smooth edge gradients; spatial area is highest on the mid-flank and neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the underbelly.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, light-cream negative space forming a continuous interconnected graph; junction nodes exhibit high connectivity with frequent tri-radial intersections and consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the upper neck; hair clusters create a jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic avian organisms (oxpeckers) attached to the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck, creating localized dark pixel clusters and partial occlusion of the mane.
